info.title: VNC Systems ERP API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the currently implemented ERP API routes. Request and response behavior is defined by the running application; database-record response fields may evolve with the schema.

servers.description: Use the same origin as the ERP deployment.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Product catalog and manual stock movements.

tags.name: POS
tags.description: Sales, POS catalog, and cash register.

get.description: Requires can_view permission for the Dashboard module.

post.summary: Sign in and set HttpOnly session cookies

get.summary: Restore the current session and profile

post.summary: Revoke the session and clear authentication cookies

get.summary: List modules assigned to the current user
List active users, modules, and assignments

put.summary: Set or remove a user's module permissions
put.description: Requires the active admin role. Setting all permissions to false removes the assignment.

post.description: Requires can_edit on the clients module.

Requires clients edit permission. Retry an uncertain request using exactly the same id and body. Purchases cannot exceed the credit limit; payments and negative adjustments cannot reduce the balance below zero. Positive adjustments increase debt. This does not create POS sales.
Requires can_edit on the inventory module. A quantity greater than zero is required for entry and exit movements; adjustment may use zero.

get.summary: List current register movements and totals

post.summary: Create a movement in the current register

post.description: Product prices and availability are locked during checkout; inventory, sale items and applicable cash movements are recorded atomically.

get.summary: Search the active POS product catalog
Get the current user's open register
List the current user's in-app notifications

patch.summary: Mark one or all current-user notifications as read

get.summary: Get the current user's external notification preferences

200.description: Current preferences, or disabled defaults when none are saved.

put.summary: Save explicit SMS and WhatsApp consent

get.summary: Process a batch of queued external notifications

200.description: Delivery results for the claimed batch.

post.summary: Email the current report PDF to the authenticated user
post.description: Requires can_view permission for Reports. The recipient is the authenticated account email and cannot be supplied in the request.

422.description: The account has no valid email address.

503.description: SendGrid is not configured or is temporarily unavailable.

cronAuth.description: Server-side CRON_SECRET. The endpoint is not scheduled while external notification delivery is paused.

Limit.description: Maximum records requested for the page.

Record.description: A database record returned by the route. Its fields depend on the underlying table and may evolve with the schema.

AttendanceCreate.description: Latitude and longitude fields must be provided as pairs.

AttendanceUpdate.description: At least one field is required. Latitude and longitude fields must be provided as pairs.

ModulePermission.description: Write permissions require can_view to be true.

DashboardMetrics.description: Current-month completed sales, stock, active customers, all-time income, recent sales, and low-stock products.

OkObject.description: Successful response with a JSON object.

OkArray.description: Successful response with a JSON array.

PaginatedArray.description: Paginated JSON array. The cash movement route instead returns a totals envelope.

CountedArray.description: Successful paginated JSON array with total count.

AuthSession.description: Returns only an authenticated flag and sets HttpOnly access and refresh token cookies.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly sb-access-token and sb-refresh-token cookies with SameSite=Lax.

Forbidden.description: The profile is inactive or lacks the required permission.

CrossSiteRequest.description: The request origin is missing or does not match the application origin.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request body must use the application/json media type.

NotFound.description: The requested record was not found.

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with current business state.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server or service configuration error.
